description: ToS risk-scoring API for AI agents: scan terms of service for risky clauses (risk scores, pass/flag/block verdicts, quote-grounded clause extraction), check agent-friendliness (does the ToS even allow bots?), monitor terms for changes with webhook alerts, and read a public ToS risk leaderboard. 12 MCP tools; stdio + streamable-http transports.
